slot.brief: Given mean and variance of a data set, find the mean and variance/SD after the transformation yᵢ = axᵢ + b; property-based, easy.

stem: A data set has mean $4$ and variance $9$. If each observation $x_i$ is replaced by $y_i=2x_i+3$, the new mean and variance are

verdicts.working: Mean transforms as 2(4)+3=11; variance transforms as 2²(9)=36.

working:
$\bar y=2\bar x+3=2(4)+3=11$; $\operatorname{Var}(y)=2^2\operatorname{Var}(x)=4(9)=36$.

Independent check: Mean transforms as 2(4)+3=11; variance transforms as 2²(9)=36.
